edges.relationship: package substrates supplied to STATS ChipPAC Korea (OSAT)

contracts.signal: Daeduck's H1 2026 half-year report (filed 08-13-2026) names STATS ChipPAC Korea among its major customers alongside Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix and Amkor Technology Korea. The >=10% customer table is anonymised (A KRW 135,447M / 18.1%, B KRW 121,293M / 16.2%, C KRW 106,215M / 14.2% of H1 revenue KRW 747,289M), so no amount is attributed to STATS ChipPAC.

edges.relationship: CCL and prepreg supply for Daeduck package substrates/PCBs

contracts.signal: Daeduck's H1 2026 half-year report (filed 08-13-2026) lists LG Chem (with Doosan Electronics) as the main supplier of CCL - purchases KRW 96,132M, 60.38% of raw-material purchases - and (with Doosan Electronics) of prepreg - KRW 40,997M, 25.75%. CCL unit price KRW 107,731 per m2 in H1 2026 vs KRW 100,872 in FY2025; the filing cites CCL price rises as the main input-cost change. LG Chem is named first for CCL.
contracts.units: H1 2026, CCL and prepreg, per m2 pricing
contracts.value: CCL KRW 96,132M and prepreg KRW 40,997M (shared with Doosan Electronics and others)
